summary: Round 1 REJECTED with 5 divergences; all five were closed in CODE, with no acceptance criterion and no accepted revision amended or weakened. Round 2 PASS: AC-1..AC-8 and R1..R8 all delivered and covered, scope discipline clean (findings 14/15/17-22/24/26-29 untouched, sweep_outbox's duplicate guard left alone). Three non-blocking documentation nits, all since fixed.

round_1_divergences.divergence: --commit applied only two of the three named main-tree guards; has_staged_changes was omitted, which also left the extraction's own stated rationale false (the third guard then had no second caller).
round_1_divergences.resolution: FIXED — guard added, plus a test that stages an unrelated file.

round_1_divergences.divergence: An added 'unverifiable' arm collapsed anchorless same-id appends and merely warned, defended in a module docstring as a departure from an ACCEPTED revision. The plan was not amended, so the file and the code disagreed silently.
round_1_divergences.resolution: FIXED — arm removed, R2 implemented as written. The defence's premise was false: both of triage.py's append constructors set originalTs unconditionally and 684/684 real appends carry one, so anchorless records and id collisions are the same-sized population. Fallout: three existing fixtures modelled a 'refresh' with anchorless lines no writer can emit and now carry originalTs.

round_1_divergences.divergence: 'Reports fatally' returned the soft 'buffered' status when a failed checkout AND a failed put-back leave the tracked log MISSING — a state no replay can complete.
round_1_divergences.resolution: FIXED — dedicated 'error' status, propagated so sweep_outbox stops on it.

round_1_divergences.divergence: Five of the enumerated fault-injection items had no test: backup-write failure, publish failure, failed salvage adoption, invalid-UTF-8 byte-faithfulness, and the old/new import smoke test.
round_1_divergences.resolution: FIXED — all added, including a per-module import in an isolated -I subprocess.

round_1_divergences.divergence: The named unit pin (action == 'clean' AND warnings != [] at sweep_quarantine.decide) did not exist; only the end-to-end proof did.
round_1_divergences.resolution: FIXED — added with a collision contrast and a no-same-id control.

round_2_verification.fixture_updates_challenged: Judged FAITHFUL on independent evidence, not on assertion: both append constructors in shared/scripts/triage.py set the anchor; the tracked log shows a 1:1 ratio of append lines to non-empty originalTs; and .shipwright/triage.jsonl:285 (trg-60ef91fb — the very incident the regression is named after) is a refreshed append carrying the FIRST append's timestamp as originalTs while ts moved. The pre-change fixtures omitted the field entirely, a shape no writer produces. Assertions unchanged; only the inputs were corrected.
round_2_verification.error_status_challenged: Handled at every level it can surface — producer, sole production consumer (sweep_outbox), and the pre-existing SweepResult 'error' reporting path. setup_iterate_worktree prints and continues, which is pre-existing for all four error reasons and deliberate (aborting mid-setup would strand a half-created worktree).

nits_since_fixed: A dangling :func:`_classify_group` reference after the rename to _is_supersession.
A mini-plan risk bullet that claimed only one class of test edit; now enumerates all four.
A '684 of 684' figure that does not reproduce as a raw substring count (638) — the method is now stated, and both figures describe the same 1:1 property.
